resources.string: Let other apps play at the same time

Normally starting music here stops whatever else was playing, and something else starting stops InterTune. Turn this on and both apps can sound together, which is the point if you want music over a lecture or a video. The cost is real: InterTune will no longer pause for a phone call, duck for a navigation prompt, or stop for an alarm. Applies the next time playback starts.
